description: Experiment 3: pure MPI vs MPI + OpenMP. The fixed problem P on 256 cores, split between ranks and threads in seven ways, from 256 ranks x 1 thread (pure MPI) to 4 ranks x 64 threads. The threads of a rank share its memory, so they must fit on one node. On Vanda every layout runs on four nodes with 64 cores each, 32 per socket, so 8 x 32 is one rank per socket and 4 x 64 one rank per node. Pure OpenMP is experiment 2; the GPU runs of this experiment are described in docs/experiment_plan.md. Decomposition and exchange stay at the baseline, so only the layout changes.
